text: DotExpand[exp] expands dot products in exp.
DOT[a x + b y + c z, d + e + f] DotExpand[%]
\[a d x+a e x+a f x+b d y+b e y+b f y+c d z+c e z+c f z\]
DeclareNonCommutative /@ {a, b, c, d, e, f}; DotExpand[DOT[a x + b y + c z, d + e + f]]
\[x a.d+x a.e+x a.f+y b.d+y b.e+y b.f+z c.d+z c.e+z c.f\]
UnDeclareNonCommutative /@ {a, b, c, d, e, f}; DotExpand[DOT[a x + b y + c z, d + e + f]]
\[a d x+a e x+a f x+b d y+b e y+b f y+c d z+c e z+c f z\]
